Onlookers commented: The aloof and abstinent Great Designer Forrester, has perished under the gentle blade!
—

Reporter: “We heard that Mr. Forrester designed this for free. Is that rumor true?”

rebirth-counterattack-with-space:
In her past life, she lived with guilt all her life, and even when she finally saw her enemies get their retribution, it could not heal the deep scars in her heart.
Rebirth finally gave her the chance to turn everything around.
Armed with her inherited space and a wealth of materials, watch how she compensates for her regrets and harvests a fulfilling and happy life in that era of material scarcity...
But why was the icy, indifferent man, whom she had a vague liking for in her past life, still so devilishly clever, so ruthlessly exposing her biggest secret so quickly?
The new book “The Fierce and Charming Wife's Rebirth” was released on May 31.
The new book “The Space of the Shepherd's Delicate Wife's Rebirth” has been uploaded.
reborn-before-the-apocalypse-the-ice-que:
Betrayed by her best friend and devoured by zombies, Neve Sinclair wakes up weeks before the world ends.
This time she has a cultivation space, a family ready to fight, and a husband nobody approved of, who happens to be the most powerful man in the city.
Zombies, drought demons, and monsters are coming. So is her revenge
**Important note: This is not a slow born story. It is not going to take 400 chapters for the leads to commit to a real relationship. **
reincarnated-in-a-world-of-mana-as-a-mec:
What did death feel like?
Ezekiel didn't want to remember. He wished to never experience that void expanse of nothingness ever again.
Luckily he had been reincarnated into a world with magic and the sorts. But as a Mechanic!
Watch as Ezekiel defies his manaless destiny by walking the path given to him by that Being as a Mechanic born to rule over all.
He had been an ordinary person in his last life but he refused to allow that term follow him into the next.
“I can still become someone important. Not as an Awakened from Taia, but as a Battle Mechanic from Earth!”
ruin-wielder:
“MY DICK!!!!”

Fatty Zhang, the menace of Shanghai, who dies by someone crushing his crotch by landing on him with a parachute in the middle of a highway.
When he was dying, he made a mistake and unknowingly wished for a weird system that was given to him when he was reborn in the cultivation world.
In a world where Heaven’s chosen are all around and fated villains everywhere, he wakes up in the most eye-catching clan of them all, yeah eye-catching, their clan’s power was that they were good-looking to the point Immortals looked pale in front of them.
Can the new prince of beauty survive the Cultivation world, or he will die in a ditch somewhere in the vast cultivation world.

shock-the-spell-is-in-english:
Lugh woke up to find that he had transmigrated to a hundred million years later.
Earth was now in the midst of a magical era, where mages were icons of nobility, commanding the energies of the world and unleashing devastating spells. Despite his transmigration, Lugh realized that he was a piece of trash when it came to magic, but just as he was giving up on being a mage, he realized in shock that the world’s magics were written in English!
Unimaginable power could be obtained when the incantations are read. Saying Thousandfold Meditation accelerated training by ten thousand times, allowing one to reach the level of Archwizard in a single day.
Likewise, saying Super Flame Dragon would conjure a divine dragon of flames that stood ten thousand meters tall, while Billion Thunderbolts would summon dark clouds, with a billion thunderbolts descending upon a target in the blink of an eye.
Hence, with this special talent, Lugh became the youngest God of Mystics in the era of magic under a year!
sss-rank-10x-reward-system-accepting-dis:
Wang Chen was a nobody—mocked, beaten, and left to rot at the bottom of the cultivation world.
Until one day...
[Ding! 10x Return System Activated.]
Whatever his disciples achieved, he would gain tenfold!
If they cultivated to Foundation Building, his lifespan grew a thousand years.
If they comprehended a sword technique, his became divine.
While his disciples struggled to survive, Wang Chen quietly soared beyond heaven’s limits.
And when the Eternal Emperors finally asked how he became so strong…
He smiled faintly.
“It’s all because of my disciples’ hard work.”
sss-ranked-demon-hunter-the-prodigy:
Forty years ago, demons invaded the eastern continent. Coming from another realm, they hunted the humans, and people soon began to wage war with them. Before long, there were those among the humans who inherited the demons' abilities.
Demon hunters are currently the most in-demand profession. Although the chance of dying during a raid was high, the hunters were mostly popular among the common people. If you have some demon blood in your body, then the path to the Hunter's Association is open to you.
Year 2066, Seoul. The territory of the former city is divided into three parts. Green Zone, Orange Zone and Red Dangerous Zone. Although mostly ordinary people and workers lived in the green zone, there was a chance for demons to get into it. That's why demon hunters patrol the whole area, sacrificing themselves for the lives of people.
The main character, Lee Ki-hyun, inherited 50% demon blood and became the world's first SSS-ranked demon hunter. He will have to go through the path of a demon and learn the truth about his parents to save humanity.
sweeping-him-off-his-feet:
Warning… Matured content!!
“You,” Augustine began, his voice firm and direct. “I'm making you an offer: we get married, immediately. This isn't a request, it's a demand.” Augustine's uttered with a piercing gaze.
Charles scoffed. “What type of bullshit is that?” He fired back.
***
Augustine Wales is a cold CEO who is known as the most successful and influential business man in Country H.
His name alone commanded respect, his steely gaze and cold demeanor strike fear into even the most hardened of hearts. He was a man of few words, each syllable weighted with the power of his position.
On the eve of Augustine Wales 29th birthday, he received an unexpected call from his family, their demands clear and uncompromising: find a spouse, or forfeit your stake in the family's vast wealth and influence.
In that very moment after receiving the phone call, the gaze of Augustine fell upon a young man named Charles Donald and without thinking twice, Augustine immediately made a proposal to Charles, but was met with a swift rejection.
Augustine's proposal was rooted in desperation but little did he know that fate was drawing him toward a future he never could have predicted.…
sweet-wife-in-my-arms: For his sake, she was willing to abandon her career as the best actress and be his wife. With her own network, money and unscrupulous methods, she helped him rise to the top of the world. He, on the other hand, held another woman in his embrace and kicked her away with no mercy. It turned out that all he ever wanted was her rare blood type, her six-month-old child’s cord blood. It was her life… When she opened her eyes again, she returned to her 20-year-old self. Time repeated and her life rewound. In this life, she would live well.
the-alphas-secret-luna:
When Orion, the leader of the Nightshade Pack, finds an injured woman near his territory, he makes an impulsive decision to bring her into his pack for treatment. Doubts linger, as she may be a spy sent by the Enclave, led by the ruthless Luna, Victoria.
What was supposed to be a straightforward case of recovery quickly becomes complicated. When Sophia awakens, she is plagued by amnesia, remembering only her name.
Orion faces a dilemma: should he send her away or allow her to stay? Ultimately, he decides to keep her until her memories return. As Sophia adjusts to life in the Nightshade Pack, a deep connection forms between her and Orion. They begin to realize they belong together, but what will happen when Sophia’s memories start returning in fragments? Will those memories destroy not only their bond but also the safety of the entire pack?
NB: Luna in this novel is a different concept, it doesn't just mean the wife of the Alpha. And also this book is rated 18.
the-fallen-authors-heart-in-the-land-of-:
Akira Tsukihara was a romance author who despised love. Though she wrote best-selling novels filled with idealistic romance, she harbored nothing but contempt for the genre and the readers who adored it. Love, in her eyes, was a lie—an illusion that blinded people from the true forces of the world: power, betrayal, and ambition. One night, in a fit of frustration, she cursed love itself... and woke up trapped inside one of her own stories.
Reborn as Aira, a nameless peasant girl in the Kingdom of Seraphis—a world she had meticulously crafted—Akira quickly realizes that reincarnation isn’t the fantasy dream she had written about. She isn’t a noble, a princess, or a heroine blessed with beauty and power. She is a nobody. A commoner, struggling to survive in the harsh realities of the medieval world she had once designed as a mere backdrop for her grand romances.
As Aira, she faces starvation, endless labor, and the crushing weight of insignificance. But Akira was never one to accept fate. If she couldn’t escape this world, she would rewrite the story on her own terms.…
the-female-lead-decides-to-act-wickedly:
Xia Wei transmigrated as the prettiest woman in a book, but she was merely the evil cannon-fodder female supporting character. This was a novel about showbiz. In the novel, Xia Wei was the female lead's best friend. Due to Xia We's beauty, the female lead had always been secretly envious of her, but Xia Wei also kept her guard up against the female lead.
Although she knew she was pretty, any man who came into contact with the female lead would eventually fall in love with her instead. Hence, Xia Wei began to keep her distance from the female lead. After that, she capitalized on her looks to get into showbiz. She also started a relationship with her boss.
Just as she thought she'd finally moved away from the female lead's shadow, she suddenly discovered that the female lead had also become an artist at her boyfriend's company. Moreover, the female lead had a romantic relationship with her boyfriend.
Xia Wei was triggered and began to go against the female lead. She wanted the female lead to know her place and back off by leaving the company and her boyfriend. However, not only did Xia Wei fail, but her boyfriend also dumped her, and her reputation in showbiz plummeted.…
the-game-where-i-was-rank-one-became-rea:
Strategic MC • Kingdom Building • Divine System • Ruthless Protagonist • Empire Growth
The world of Theos Online was a battlefield of gods. Players built civilizations, shaped faith, and waged divine wars for supremacy.
At the top stood Zephyr — Rank One. Untouchable. Calculating. Ruthless.
He didn’t just win. He engineered inevitability.
But in the real world, anonymity is fragile. When his identity is exposed, a coordinated smear campaign tears his life apart, stripping him of reputation, future, and finally — breath.
Death was supposed to be the end.
Instead, he awakens in another world.
Different sky. Different history.
Same Divine System.
The rules that governed Theos Online now govern reality itself.
While others pray to survive, Zephyr understands the code beneath the gods. He knows the exploits. The hidden mechanics. The logic no one else sees.
He may not know this world’s past.
But he knows exactly how to conquer its future.
From a starving village to a rising divine empire, Zephyr will bend faith into machinery, turn belief into power, and reduce rival gods to footnotes in history.
The game is gone.
The system remains.
And this time, there are no respawns.
the-general-loves-to-collect-little-red-:
The most domineering, arrogant and beautiful Omega in the Tarot Empire, Le Yao was arranged to marry General Xu Yao, who was known as the ruthless King of Hell.
However, the “Le Yao” now was a crossed-over soul from the earth!
After X days of marriage he gave Xu Yao a note…
It was written:
– Little Red Flower Agreement!-
Don’t swear a day, get 1 little red flower
Keep reading every night, get 2 little red flowers
Do good deeds, get 3 little red flowers
Get 300 little red flowers, you can pa pa pa!
Xu Yao: Hmph! Was Lao Zi like a dog in heat and want to do it with you?
But after a month…
Xu Yao: Hurry! I still need three more flowers, whose family is bankrupt this time? I’ll send a charity money, hurry!!!
the-glory-after-rebirth:
A letter to break off the engagement leads Ling Family in Tangyang to endless doom. And he, Ling Zhang, is tortured to death after his legs are cruelly broken.
This time after rebirth, he swears to restore glory to his family and to seek revenge. The very first he should do is to break the engagement himself!
Yuewen Family? Far in the capital enjoying high privilege and glory?
I simply don’t care.
You think yourself some delicious cake that everyone crazes to grab a bite?
Bah! Too hard that it hurts my teeth!
Yet never has Ling Zhang expected that this ‘hard cake’ would promise him a life of glory after rebirth.
the-great-storyteller:
Yun Woo is the youngest author in history to enter the literature world. His debut work was a massive hit but this success was short lived for the unprepared.
A miraculous second chance comes his way one day.
This is the beginning of that journey.
the-hidden-dragon-in-law:
James Ye is a son-in-law everyone looks down upon, but no one knows his true identity is that of a young master from a top family.
Those who scorn him will ultimately kneel before him, calling him 'Master' in awe and fear!
the-hidden-monster-of-house-vale:
In a world where strength is everything, the weak are destined to be abandoned.
Lucien Vale, the talentless young master of the fallen Vale family, becomes the laughingstock of the nobility after losing his fiancée and failing to awaken any real power. Desperate to change his fate, he performs a forbidden ritual connected to the legendary Lost Atlas.
But the ritual goes horribly wrong.
When Lucien opens his eyes again, a different soul is staring back from within his body—one far colder, far more calculating, and far more dangerous than the original owner ever was.
Armed with the mysterious Lost Atlas and a soul-devouring system, the new Lucien begins his rise through hidden relics, ancient inheritances, and merciless ambition.
Because in this world—
only monsters reach the top.
the-ugly-love-of-monster-girls:
Markus spent his life piecing together fragments of his past life on Earth, flickers of faces, half-remembered streets, the ghost of a world that no longer existed.
Slowly, gradually, he’d finally found his footing in this new world of monstrous beings. He felt grounded, as if his fractured memories could finally settle into something resembling a family.
But it all went downhill from there.
A lingering touch, a promise, an obsession. As if fate itself was playing a cruel joke, his life begins to spiral down. Gradually tumbling down like a crescendo of madness, dragging him deeper into something inescapable.
Every attempt to claw his way back only pulls him further down, like a bottomless pit with no end in sight.
How much can a person endure before they break? And when they do, can they ever truly piece themselves back together?
the-villainess-reverses-the-hourglass:
With the marriage of her prostitute mother to the Count, Aria’s status in society skyrocketed immediately. After leading a life of luxury, Aria unfairly meets death because of her sister Mielle’s schemes. And right before she dies, she sees an hourglass fall as if it were a fantasy. And just like that, she was miraculously brought back to the past.
“I want to become a very elegant person, just like my sister, Mielle.”
In order to face the villainess, she must become an even more wicked villainess. This was the new path Aria chose to take revenge on Mielle who murdered both her and her mother.
the-whole-dynasty-spoils-the-tyrants-bel:
Emperor Yongning craved a daughter but had eighteen sons instead. Desperate, he consulted a diviner: “Am I fated to have a daughter?” The diviner replied, “Your Majesty, you already have a daughter.” Yongning dismissed it: “I have eighteen sons, no daughter.” The diviner insisted: “Seventeen sons, one daughter.” Yongning scoffed, “Impossible!”
Until one day, Yongning’s eighteenth “son,” Jun Ning, appeared in a pink dress, hair in twin buns, beaming: “Father, I’m not a prince—I’m your longed-for princess!” Yongning spluttered, “Nonsense! You’re my son.” Jun Ning retorted, “No, I’m your daughter.”
“Guard! Verify her!” The results were undeniable—Jun Ning was a girl.
Yongning’s eyes widened: “...I... I have a precious daughter!”
this-is-really-not-mechanical-ascension:
As soon as he opened his eyes, Li Ming was plunged into these tumultuous interstellar spaces, where countless civilizations held their shotguns at the ready, eyeing everything in the universe with covetous intent. For him, the most crucial issue at hand was solving the problem of food and warmth.

【Thunderclap Armored Exoskeleton—Grade D】

villain-after-intercepting-the-female-le:
Jiang Che traversed into a merged novel world, becoming the major villain in the novel. His story begins with the descent of a divine healer.

The ‘lolita’ senior sister even drags Jiang Che to her home daily to show him her newly bought white silk stockings…
After Ye Chen comes down the mountain, he is completely enraged seeing his senior sisters one by one turn away from him. Jiang Che then innocently expresses: “Chenzi… it’s not my fault, your senior sisters are just too enthusiastic…”
